title.zh: 以模擬與數位孿生，預測並降低爆炸風險。
title.en: Predicting and reducing blast risk with simulation and digital twins.

lead.zh: 我們結合爆炸數值模擬、人體損傷分析、數位孿生與試驗驗證，為關鍵基礎設施、科技園區、資料中心與能源設施提供風險評估、防護設計與決策支援。
lead.en: We combine blast simulation, human injury analysis, digital twins and experimental validation to deliver risk assessment, protective design and decision support for critical infrastructure, science parks, data centers and energy facilities.

title.zh: 從人體、設施到城市的爆炸防護研究
title.en: Blast protection from the human body to facilities and cities

lead.zh: 以數值模擬為核心，向上整合成數位孿生平台，向下以材料與爆炸試驗驗證。
lead.en: Numerical simulation at the core, integrated upward into digital-twin platforms and validated downward by material and explosive tests.

note.zh: 以上為實驗室自製的情境示意圖，以經驗式與程序化模型繪製，非特定專案成果。
note.en: Illustrations made by the lab from empirical relations and procedural models; not results of a specific project.

title.zh: 爆炸波撞上建築物的那 30 毫秒
title.en: The 30 milliseconds when a blast wave hits a building

lead.zh: 下面的動畫在你的瀏覽器裡即時計算：100 kg TNT 在地面引爆、距建築物 15 m，入射波與牆面反射波的超壓場。這是抗爆設計評估的第一步。
lead.en: Computed live in your browser: incident and reflected overpressure from 100 kg of TNT detonated on the ground 15 m from a building, the first step of any blast design assessment.

note.zh: 地面爆炸：100 kg TNT，以 1.8 倍等效藥量的半球形爆炸波計算地面反射；距建築物 15 m。入射與反射超壓採 Kinney–Graham 經驗式（示意，未含繞射與 Mach 波細節）。
note.en: Surface burst: 100 kg TNT, with ground reflection represented by a hemispherical blast of 1.8 × the charge mass; building at 15 m. Incident and reflected overpressure from the Kinney–Graham relations (illustrative; diffraction and Mach-stem details omitted).

aria.zh: 爆炸波從爆心向外傳遞、撞擊建築物並反射的壓力場動畫
aria.en: Animation of a blast wave expanding from the charge, striking a building and reflecting

lead.zh: 五類試驗能量，對應從材料、構件到人體的研究主題。
lead.en: Five testing capabilities, from materials and members to the human body.

title.zh: 把爆炸風險，變成可以計算、可以驗證的工程問題。
title.en: Turning blast risk into an engineering problem you can calculate and verify.

lead.zh: 我們為政府機關、國防單位、工程顧問、科技廠與材料廠商，提供爆炸荷載評估、抗爆設計檢核、防護材料驗證與工程審查。所有合作皆透過國立陽明交通大學產學合作與技術服務機制簽約。
lead.en: We provide blast load assessment, blast design review, protective material qualification and engineering review for government agencies, defense organizations, engineering firms, tech plants and material manufacturers. All work is contracted through NYCU's industry collaboration and technical service programs.

steps.zh: 討論範疇、提出工作項目與報價

prepTitle.en: Useful to include in your first email

prep.zh: 設施或產品類型（可概述，不需提供機敏資料）
prep.en: Type of facility or product (a summary is enough; no sensitive data)

prep.zh: 想評估的情境或威脅，例如爆炸源、藥量或距離範圍
prep.en: Scenario or threat of concern, e.g. source, charge size or distance range

prep.zh: 目的：評估、設計檢核、材料驗證或審查
prep.en: Goal: assessment, design check, material qualification or review

q.zh: 可以先簽保密協議再提供資料嗎？
q.en: Can we sign an NDA before sharing details?

a.zh: 可以。保密協議依陽明交大產學合作程序辦理，簽署前只需提供概述。
a.en: Yes. NDAs follow NYCU's industry collaboration procedures; a summary is all we need beforehand.

q.zh: 涉及國防或機敏設施的案子如何處理？
q.en: How are defense or sensitive projects handled?

a.zh: 依委託單位的資訊安全與人員管制規定執行；本網站不公開任何機敏內容。
a.en: We follow the sponsor's information-security and personnel rules. Nothing sensitive is published on this site.

q.zh: 試驗報告可以對外引用嗎？
q.en: Can test reports be cited externally?

a.zh: 報告用途與引用方式在合約中約定。若您需要認證實驗室出具的報告，我們會在洽談時先說明並協助規劃。
a.en: Use and citation are set out in the contract. If you need a report from an accredited laboratory, we will say so up front and help plan it.

a.zh: 依工作範疇、分析或試驗數量與期程估算，並依學校規定計入管理費。
a.en: From the scope, number of analyses or tests and schedule, plus the university overhead required by NYCU rules.

coi.zh: 主持人擔任設計審查委員的案件，不承接同一案的設計或顧問工作。
coi.en: When the PI serves as a design reviewer on a project, the lab does not take design or consulting work on that same project.

title.zh: 把廠區搬進電腦，在災害發生前先演練
title.en: Rehearse the incident before it happens

lead.zh: 我們正在開發結合設施模型、感測資料與爆炸模擬的數位孿生平台，用於兩類情境：
lead.en: We are developing digital-twin platforms that combine facility models, sensor data and blast simulation for two kinds of scenarios:

t.zh: 關鍵基礎設施的戰災情境

d.zh: 推演不同威脅下的損傷範圍、功能中斷與修復優先順序。
d.en: Explore damage extent, loss of function and repair priorities under different threats.

t.zh: 園區與廠區的意外爆炸

d.zh: 科技園區、工業區、資料中心與能源中心的爆炸風險評估，涵蓋預防、監測與解決方案比較。
d.en: Risk assessment for science parks, industrial zones, data centers and energy hubs, covering prevention, monitoring and comparison of mitigation options.

try.zh: 試試看：在廠區圖上點一下設定爆炸位置，拖曳滑桿調整藥量。
try.en: Try it: click the site map to place the explosion and drag the slider to change the charge.

ear.zh: 耳膜破裂門檻（35 kPa）距離

note.zh: 示意用途：地面爆炸，以 1.8 倍等效藥量的 Kinney–Graham 經驗式計算，未考慮建物遮蔽與反射。實際專案以三維數值模擬與現地資料為準。
note.en: Illustrative only: surface burst from the Kinney–Graham relations with 1.8 × charge mass, ignoring shielding and reflection. Real projects use 3D simulation and site data.

aria.zh: 廠區平面圖上的爆炸超壓範圍互動示意
aria.en: Interactive map of blast overpressure ranges on a site plan

title.zh: 爆震波通過頭部的幾毫秒內，腦組織發生了什麼
title.en: What happens to the brain in the milliseconds a blast wave passes

lead.zh: 結合生醫工程與防護工程，我們用人體有限元素模型把爆炸荷載轉換成可量化的傷害指標。
lead.en: Combining biomedical and protective engineering, we use finite-element human body models to turn blast loading into quantifiable injury metrics.

d.zh: 以 GHBMC 人體模型計算爆震波下的顱內壓與腦組織應變，並建立壓力–衝量（P-I）傷害判定圖。
d.en: GHBMC human body models to compute intracranial pressure and brain tissue strain under blast, and pressure–impulse (P-I) injury charts.

d.zh: 評估爆炸、射擊等衝擊式噪音的峰值聲壓與暴露量，判斷聽力受損風險與防護需求。
d.en: Peak pressure and exposure from explosions and weapon firing, to judge hearing-damage risk and protection needs.

d.zh: 分析頭盔與內襯在爆震波及衝擊下對頭頸部的防護效果。
d.en: How helmets and liners protect the head and neck under blast and impact.

cap.zh: 示意動畫：爆震波由側向通過頭部，色階代表腦部相對應變。程序化示意模型，非實際分析結果。
cap.en: Illustrative animation: a blast wave passes the head from the side; colours show relative brain strain. Procedural model, not an analysis result.
